company.name: Apex Clean Energy & Minerals
company.mission: Transitioning heavy haulage and industrial processing to 100% net-zero emissions through electrification, automated microgrids, and battery storage.

role.title: Systems & Automation Engineer (Vacation / Undergraduate / Junior)
role.overview: Join our engineering team supporting the deployment of heavy electric haulage systems, battery telemetry analytics, and autonomous charging infrastructure.

advertisedRequirements: Currently pursuing or completed a degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electrical, or Systems Engineering
High analytical and mathematical capability with proficiency in Python or MATLAB
Experience analyzing telemetry, sensor time-series data, or equipment diagnostics
Familiarity with relevant Australian Standards and safety regulations
Strong technical documentation, communication, and project coordination skills

identifiedOperationalBottlenecks.teamStrain: Senior engineers lose 15+ hours/week manually parsing noisy CSV sensor logs and diagnosing transient battery fault codes.
Manual cross-referencing of AS/NZS electrical and mechanical compliance specs creates bottlenecks before equipment sign-off.
Engineers are backlogged updating FMEA matrices, HAZOP logs, and weekly shift handoff documentation.
Writing repetitive parameter sweep scripts for battery thermal models drains lead engineering time.
